name: poc-extension-hotreload
description: Chrome extension POC with hot reload via WebSocket

scripts.dev: concurrently "vite build --watch --config vite.popup.config.ts" "vite build --watch --config vite.sidebar.config.ts" "node dev-server/server.js"
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.popup.config.ts && vite build --config vite.sidebar.config.ts
